Industrial organisation

Industrial organisation studies how firms compete and how market structure affects prices, entry, innovation, and consumer outcomes. It examines markets in which firms have some degree of market power.

The field provides tools for analysing competition, monopolies, oligopolies, product differentiation, and regulation. These concepts are useful for understanding how firms behave when markets are not perfectly competitive.
